smallest_safe_change.location: MoveWorkProjection.scala original physical Section construction, before lead at 2907; do not change the text gate or stationary user guard.
smallest_safe_change.preserve: Keep part/Section association and each original root use's price episode through fallback and functional replacement. Associate each physical history's actual capture offsets with its owner Section, together with that episode's checks and replies.
smallest_safe_change.price_ownership: Separate material-only trailing Sections are insufficient: an unavailable close would then see no local hasEpisode and could discard the price. Actual prices must stay with the corresponding episode before protection. Shared actual capture can join those dependent episodes or use the existing single-owner closure; a shared quiet root, endpoint, PV or wording must not join unrelated lifetimes.
smallest_safe_change.required_and_focus: Retain each episode's owned required/focus refs, and do not globally union them before deciding which episode survives.
smallest_safe_change.completion_sources: Successfully narrowed episodes contribute their original selected uses/actions only; generated closure prices are duties, not new seeds. A deferred episode contributes its original retained source contents. Repeat completion must not enlarge either set.
smallest_safe_change.numeric_and_conditional: Keep original primary pair and score receipt unchanged. A conditional function can coexist with a mistake whose entire reason is unconfirmed; it cannot label the supplied local Rd6 branch as the actual mistake cause.
smallest_safe_change.sufficiency_limit: Boundary preservation alone does not reduce the existing broad fallback selection. It enables a valid compact functional answer to move unrelated episodes to detail and prevents a single unavailable account from reviving the entire core. The general importance gate remains a separate unresolved task.

meaningful_regressions: Functional replacement with two independent old root questions: one relocated quiet user's account unavailable, the other stationary user's actual loss/recovery complete. Keep the former full price episode, narrow only the latter and send its endpoint background to detail.
Missing intermediate physical identity must retain that specific old episode; completing another episode cannot fabricate safety or remove its capture/check price.
Original actual root capture, immediate check reply, promotion identity, support user's loss and required rook exchange stay visible with one capture owner.

NB1 actual numerical mistake stays unchanged; a purpose-only reading must not replace the unexplained numerical cause. Conditional supported/unsupported Rd6 is named as a local example.

A different legal recapturer keeps the local fact true but prevents provider-specific central promotion; strong Qb7 defence prevents a forced queen-loss claim.
Append unrelated quiet lifetime facts to a different closed episode: keep them in detail rather than changing the chosen compact answer. An actually connected selected new price must remain core.
